decision: 依 TL 安全審核 S-01／S-03／S-06／S-07／F-06，PM 8a27d864；交 CI 管理員核定。
purpose: Functional regression for the approved review items.
data: Existing unit and disposable functional fixtures.
repetitions: One check per scenario under the existing triggers.
thresholds: Preserve existing correctness, coverage and CI gates.
cost: No new job or workload scale. Estimated incremental runtime in seconds.

cases: S-01 device review checks the actor and records completed decisions
approving and rejecting record who did it and any note
the pending queue maps rows to the shape the approver sees
S-06 validates the verified session timestamps
expiresIn must carry a unit, because a bare number means milliseconds
F-06 applies the same credential fields to request and system logs
logging service flushes registry loggers once and separately flushes an injected logger
S-06 confirms a newer persisted version and reuses it on the next request
S-06 rejects a version the database does not confirm
S-06 reports service unavailable when a newer version cannot be confirmed
a token older than the current version is revoked, the current one is not
a token without ver is treated as revoked
the first revocation takes a never-revoked subject from 0 to 1
revocation takes effect locally without waiting for the next refresh
a failed refresh keeps serving the old snapshot and says how stale it is
fail open is time boxed: past the cap the snapshot stops counting
a successful refresh picks up another instance's revocation
a refresh that would exceed maxCachedSubjects fails open and leaves the old snapshot untouched
S-03 starts a fresh attempt count after lock expiry
